hypothesis: Temporary inventory/flow imbalance can mean-revert after extreme two-bar RSI; distinguish profitable states from repeated stop-loss states using only entry-time features learned in 2017.
source: Official FXCM indicative paired BID/ASK M1, complete UTC M5/M15 aggregation; crossed ASK opens prohibit new entries
source_limitations: Lowest-spread Active Trader indicative quotes, not verified executable broker prices
No raw archive/price redistribution; provider specifies personal use
entry_price: Current observed ASK open plus adverse slippage
exit_price: BID stop/target or current observed BID open minus adverse slippage
independence_note: 2017-2021 calendar periods were used in earlier disclosed research. 2022-04 through 2024-09 strategy outcomes remain untouched; source-only availability/quality checks are permitted.

pattern_learning.target: After-cost net pips per currency unit from all natural baseline trades; stop reasons retained for separate diagnosis
pattern_learning.keep_leaf: Training mean net pips > 0 AND training net win rate >= 0.5
pattern_learning.training_filter_lock: Write each fitted tree and rule hashes before any selection-validation run. Do not revise using validation or final outcomes.
pattern_learning.pattern_reports: Every development stop trade and winning trade includes entry-available feature values; feature group comparisons are exploratory correlations, not causal proof

stress_rule: Multiply actual observed entry spread, per-side slippage, commission bps and minimum commission together; carry remains zero in funded currency model

selection_criteria.rank: Maximum minimum development/validation net return; tie by validation net return then stable variant name

selection: One exact config selected and frozen before final; do not test alternatives on final

final_criteria.strong_expectancy_evidence: One-sided 95% daily-return block-bootstrap lower bound > 0; an interval including zero is labeled uncertain

execution_notes: Features derived only from completed trading bars, not synthesized calendar bars
Orders use subsequent fresh quotes; never a signal close
Indicators retain prior trading-bar history across gaps; entry signal freshness is independently enforced
Max observed-bar holding horizon may last longer across missing bars; all actual exit times are retained
Observed ASK crossing blocks entry only; do not remove valid BID exit bars
Ambiguous stop/target same OHLC bar takes stop first
Exclude sample-end liquidations from natural count and win rate but retain their costs and PnL in account totals
Research PnL never credits the existing paper ledger; no production activation from a diagnostic result
previous_history: All earlier 608 hourly and 618 intraday operating configurations remain disclosed; this round adds 12 fixed/learned intraday configurations, not a claim of a fresh clean slate.
